info.long_name: Number of students enrolled
info.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
info.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} students were enrolled.

info.long_name: Number of students up to date for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students up to date for all required vaccines.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students who have completed all age-appropriate required immunizations.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

info.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students up to date for all required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students who have completed all age-appropriate required immunizations (fully immunized / up to date at the time of the survey).
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

info.long_name: Number of students conditionally enrolled
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students admitted conditionally while completing required immunizations.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students who are conditionally enrolled: permitted to attend while in the process of completing required immunizations and not yet overdue.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were conditionally enrolled.

info.long_name: Proportion of students conditionally enrolled
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students admitted conditionally while completing required immunizations.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students who are conditionally (or provisionally) enrolled - permitted to attend while in the process of completing required immunizations and not yet overdue.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were conditionally enrolled.

info.long_name: Number of students out of compliance with immunization requirements
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students who are not complete, not conditionally enrolled, and not exempt.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students the state classifies as out of compliance: no complete record, no conditional status, and no exemption on file.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were out of compliance with immunization requirements.

info.long_name: Proportion of students out of compliance with immunization requirements
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are not complete, not conditionally enrolled, and not exempt.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students the state classifies as out of compliance: no complete record, no conditional status, and no exemption on file. Washington reports this as the residual after complete, conditional and exempt students.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were out of compliance with immunization requirements.

info.long_name: Number of students with any vaccination exemption

West Virginia additionally reports a grade stratum "all, permanent": the number of permanent medical exemptions in force in that year across all grades. Those rows are a standing count rather than a per-year addition, and must not be added to the kindergarten, 7th- and 12th-grade rows, which they partly duplicate.

info.long_name: Why rate_complete carries no value on this row
info.short_description: Whether rate_complete was published as a number, suppressed, not reported, or censored at a bound.
info.long_description: Per-measure companion to rate_complete. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.
info.statement: In {location}, rate_complete was {value}.

flag_complete.long_name: Why rate_complete carries no value on this row
flag_complete.short_description: Whether rate_complete was published as a number, suppressed, not reported, or censored at a bound.
flag_complete.long_description: Per-measure companion to rate_complete. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.
